name: DOOM 3
description: DOOM 3 is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter and survival horror game and the third main game in the Doom series.

gog.store_details: GOG sells this bundled with the 2012 BFG Edition, and Heroic installs the two as separate library entries — this one is the classic game (its folder ends '.../DOOM 3'). The BFG Edition is a different game with no EAX.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: DOOM 3 ships with its EAX sound options off, so there's no reverb.
